title: The 10 Best Mold-Resistant Shower Curtains and Liners
h1: The 10 Best Mold-Resistant Shower Curtains and Liners
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for mold-resistant shower curtains and liners, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mold-resistant shower curtains and liners using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Splash Home Grass PEVA 5G Shower Liner
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-gauge PEVA construction, Rustproof metal grommets at every hook point, Chlorine-free, low-odor material.
strengths: Mid-weight 5G thickness holds shape better than 3G liners without the stiffness of 8G
Metal grommets resist the tearing that starts most mildew hot spots at mounting points
No noticeable plastic odor out of the packaging, unlike vinyl at this price
Embossed texture keeps the liner from sticking to skin mid-shower
limitations: No weighted hem, billows more in strong shower airflow than the Zenna 8-Gauge pick
5G is not as tear-resistant as 8G or 10G under daily multi-person household use
Embossed texture holds slightly more soap scum in the grooves than a smooth liner
features: Rustproof metal grommets at every hook point
Grass-pattern embossed texture reduces surface cling

products.name: Zenna Home Heavyweight Shower Curtain Liner, 8-Gauge EVA
products.blurb: Key specs: 8-gauge EVA thickness, roughly 2.5x a standard 3G liner, Weighted hem keeps the bottom edge pinned against the tub, Rustproof grommets resist hook-friction tearing.
strengths: 8-gauge thickness resists the creasing that traps moisture between folds
Weighted hem stops billowing into the shower stream, reducing water escaping onto the floor
Highest rating count of any pick in this guide (12,300+), a strong daily-use durability signal
Holds up to weekly cold-water washing without cracking at the fold lines
limitations: Heavier and stiffer to hang than 3G or 5G liners, harder to fold flat for storage
Costs more per unit than thinner PEVA liners in the same lineup
Takes longer to air dry fully given the added material thickness
features: 8-gauge EVA thickness, roughly 2.5x a standard 3G liner
Weighted hem keeps the bottom edge pinned against the tub
Machine washable on cold, air dry only

products.name: Splash Home Hydro Design Soft Microfiber Shower Curtain Liner
products.blurb: Key specs: Soft microfiber surface with a water-repellent coating, Sheds water rather than absorbing it, unlike untreated fabric, Machine washable, tumble dry low.
strengths: Fabric feel and drape without the full absorption problem of untreated polyester
Water-repellent coating shortens saturation time, cutting down the window mildew needs to take hold
Works as a standalone liner or paired under a decorative fabric curtain
Machine washable without the cracking risk vinyl liners face
limitations: Water-repellent coating wears down faster than PEVA or vinyl's inherent waterproofing, typically noticeable within a year
Lower rating count (2,800) than the Zenna and Splash PEVA liners, less long-term feedback
Not a substitute for a true vinyl liner in a daily multi-person shower
features: Soft microfiber surface with a water-repellent coating
Sheds water rather than absorbing it, unlike untreated fabric

products.name: Splash Home EVA Shower Curtain Liner, Clear
products.blurb: Key specs: Clear PEVA construction, chlorine-free, Standard-gauge, lightweight liner, 72 x 72-inch fit.
strengths: Lowest price point of any liner in this guide while still resisting surface mold better than fabric
Clear design lets light through in a small bathroom, unlike opaque vinyl
PEVA offers less organic material for spores to colonize than woven fabric
limitations: Lighter gauge than the 8G or 10G Zenna picks, billows more and tears sooner at grommets
No weighted hem, needs more frequent straightening to keep water contained
Shortest expected lifespan of the picks here, typically needs replacing within 6 to 9 months of daily use

products.name: Splash Home Vinyl Shower Liner, Lightweight, Rustproof Grommets
products.blurb: Key specs: Lightweight vinyl construction, Rustproof metal grommets, 72 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Vinyl surface wipes clean in seconds and dries faster than fabric or microfiber liners
Grommets are the standout featureto resist tearing significantly longer than the unreinforced holes on entry-level liners
Fully waterproof on its own without needing a fabric layer over it
Lighter weight than the 8G and 10G vinyl/EVA picks, easier to hang solo
limitations: New-vinyl odor is noticeable for the first several days, more than the PEVA picks in this guide
Lightweight gauge means it billows more than the heavier 8G/10G options
Cannot go in a dryer, high heat warps the material

products.name: Zenna Home Weighted Microfiber Water-Repellent Shower Curtain Liner, Black
products.blurb: Key specs: Weighted hem with sewn-in weights along the bottom edge, Water-repellent microfiber surface, 72 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Weighted hem is the most effective billow control in this guide, keeps the liner pinned to the tub wall through a hot, steamy shower
Water-repellent microfiber sheds water faster than untreated fabric, reducing saturation time
Black colorway hides soap scum staining longer than white or clear liners
limitations: Costs more than the plain PEVA options in this guide for comparable gauge
Microfiber surface needs more frequent washing than smooth vinyl to prevent buildup in the weave
Weighted hem adds bulk that makes packing for travel impractical
features: Weighted hem with sewn-in weights along the bottom edge

products.name: Zenna Home Weighted Microfiber Water-Repellent Shower Curtain Liner, Bone
products.blurb: Key specs: Weighted hem with sewn-in weights, Water-repellent microfiber surface, Bone/neutral colorway.
strengths: Same weighted-hem, water-repellent microfiber build as the black version, matches neutral bathroom color schemes
Billow resistance and grommet durability identical to the top-rated black variant
Blends with more bathroom palettes than stark white or black liners
Machine washable without cracking, unlike stiffer vinyl liners
limitations: Bone color shows soap scum and mildew staining more visibly than the black variant
Lower rating count (4,300) than the black version, suggesting less overall sales volume
Same premium price as the black version despite the visibility tradeoff

products.name: Zenna Home Clear Shower Curtain Liner, Heavyweight Semi-Sheer, 10-Gauge Vinyl
products.blurb: Key specs: 10-gauge heavyweight vinyl, the thickest liner in this guide, Semi-sheer clear finish, 72 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Thickest gauge (10G) of any pick here, resists cracking and grommet tearing longer than 8G or lighter liners
Non-porous vinyl surface offers the least foothold for mold spores of any material in this guide
Semi-sheer finish lets in more light than opaque liners in a windowless bathroom
limitations: Heaviest and stiffest liner here, more awkward to hang and store than PEVA
New-vinyl odor takes several days to fully dissipate
No weighted hem included, relies on gauge stiffness alone to resist billowing
features: 10-gauge heavyweight vinyl, the thickest liner in this guide

products.name: iDesign Fabric Shower Curtain, Mildew-Resistant, Tan
products.blurb: Key specs: Antimicrobial silver-ion fabric treatment, Woven polyester construction, 72 x 72-inch standard fit.
strengths: Explicit antimicrobial treatment slows odor and mildew growth compared to untreated polyester curtains
Highest rating of any pick (4.6) tied with the Zenna 8-Gauge liner
Drapes naturally and does not require the wipe-down maintenance vinyl needs
Works as the sole visible layer for anyone who wants a fabric-only look over a separate liner
limitations: Does not block water on its own, needs a separate PEVA or vinyl liner behind it
Antimicrobial treatment slows, but does not prevent, mildew if the curtain stays wet and unwashed
Absorbs moisture and takes longer to dry than any plastic option in this guide

products.name: Zenna Home 5.5-Gauge Lightweight Recycled PEVA Stall-Sized Liner with Anti-Draft Clips
products.blurb: Key specs: 5.5-gauge lightweight recycled PEVA, 54 x 78-inch stall-specific sizing, Anti-draft clips to seal side gaps.
strengths: Purpose-cut 54 x 78-inch stall size eliminates the excess pooling fabric a standard 72x72 liner leaves on a walk-in shower floor
Anti-draft clips seal the narrow side gaps common in stall enclosures, closing the exact spot where water and drafts otherwise sneak through
Recycled PEVA material without sacrificing the chlorine-free, low-odor profile of virgin PEVA
Lightweight gauge makes it easy to hang and remove in a tight stall footprint
limitations: 5.5G is lighter than the 8G/10G picks, more prone to billowing and tearing under heavy daily use
Smallest rating count in this guide (2,100), least amount of long-term feedback
Stall sizing only fits 36 to 48-inch enclosures, not usable for a standard tub
features: Anti-draft clips to seal side gaps

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
